search_fallback: The local multi-source search aggregator returned no usable records in this run, so discovery and metadata verification used official APS and arXiv sources. This does not establish exhaustive database coverage.

dedupe.result: All three additions are new to the completed ledger. The PRE transport article is ingested using accepted metadata and its lawful corresponding author preprint. The nanowire article concerns nonlinear Breit-Wheeler angle-spin selection and is distinct from the linear Breit-Wheeler reorientation article added on 2026-09-10. The generalized-similarity article is a Boltzmann-Maxwell framework spanning several plasma regimes rather than a duplicate of a device-specific scaling study.

evidence_boundary: All three core additions are theory, author-run multigroup/PIC/fluid simulations or numerical benchmarks. None is a new experiment or a local reproduction. The accepted PRE article is represented locally by its corresponding author preprint, the positron charge and polarization are two-dimensional QED-PIC predictions under extreme idealized conditions, and the similarity laws require matched initial, boundary, collision and drive scalings.
